subtitulo: Ask in natural language to a model running on your machine. It queries the graph and prepares proposals for you to review.

formulario.etiqueta: What do you want the assistant to do?
formulario.placeholder: For example: create an NPC who runs the harbour inn and knows the protagonists…
formulario.atajo: Ctrl + Enter (⌘ + Enter on Mac) to send. Each message is an independent request.

modelo.error: Could not read the model configuration.

contexto.titulo: What it knows about the system
contexto.explicacion: Lore summary, statistics, rules and glossary the model receives, trimmed to its context size. Modules define it in context.yaml.

seguridad.texto: The assistant can read the graph, but any change becomes a pending proposal: nothing reaches the canon without your approval.

vacio.texto: Describe what you need. If it involves changes, the assistant will create proposals for you to review.
ejemplos: Summarise what we know about the main factions
Which plots are still open and who is involved?
Propose a new NPC related to the last session

turno.pensando: Thinking… local models can take a while.

error.ayudaModelo: Is Ollama running? Check LOREGRAPH_LLM_* in .env
